name: gitnest
description: A local-first multi-repository Git workspace for Windows.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/git-core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/git-cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/workspace-core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/persistence-json/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/code-analysis/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/application/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/testkit/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/design-system/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @gitnest/desktop typecheck
